snippet.title: BORE Gameplay Trailer [GRAPHICAL UPDATE]
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5000170/BORE/
https://discord.com/invite/brnrvEjcdQ

BORE is a 1–4 player co-op survival-horror extraction game. Your crew serves THE MULE, a church-sized drilling machine boring down through a stratified, whispering earth: the Fill, the Old Sea, the Ossuary, and, if the tribute demands it, the Hush. The Bureau calls what you owe it the tribute. The Bureau is politely inflexible about it.
